method: PosterTiler is checked using its local production build. Source-page statements are recorded separately from browser and exported-file observations. The image fixture is our generated 800 × 1000 pixel grid.jpg; the PDF fixture contains generated text and vector shapes.

observations: File processing and screenshot/PDF checks describe the tested local setup, not a promise about every browser or printer.

Rasterbator.io browser navigation repeatedly timed out in this environment. Its published capabilities are kept separate from our output-file checks; this run does not establish a head-to-head print result.
The PosterTiler renderer check compares source PDF pages with virtually reassembled output sheets. It does not measure paper emerging from a real printer.
